explanation: The statement is about odd–even transposition routing. It is phrased with the library's own definitions, `OrderingStep` and `PrefixSet`: the prefix sets `σ '' {j | j.castSucc < i}` must stay unchanged at every rank whose parity differs from the active one. The proof only repackages the library's own `OddEvenSorting.oddEvenRoute2`; it uses no Mathlib lemma. I grepped Mathlib for odd–even sorting or transposition-network results and found nothing. Mathlib does have decompositions of permutations into transpositions (`Equiv.Perm.swap_induction_on`, `List.formPerm`), but nothing that carries this layered, parity-constrained prefix-set routing.
